Question: Use a CTE to identify orders whose item totals don't match the order total, then list those orders.

WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(line_amount) AS item_total FROM ecommerce.public.order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, it.item_total FROM ecommerce.public.orders o JOIN item_totals it ON o.order_id = it.order_id WHERE o.total_amount <> it.item_total
